card.rule: Now, therefore, we shall expound the chapter called Dirghanjivitiya ('On Long Life').

concepts.title: श्लोक ३: दीर्घं जीवितमन्विच्छन्भरद्वाज

blocks.label: संदर्भ
blocks.text: चरकसंहिता, सूत्रस्थान, अध्याय १ — श्लोक ३। पाठ: SARIT संस्करण।

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. अनु-√इष्

blocks.label: हिन्दी
blocks.text: दीर्घ जीवन की खोज करते हुए उग्र तपस्वी भरद्वाज, देवताओं के स्वामी इन्द्र को शरण देने योग्य जानकर, उनके पास गए।

blocks.label: English
blocks.text: Seeking a long life, Bharadvaja, a man of severe austerity, approached Indra, the lord of the immortals, having understood that he was the one fit to give refuge.

blocks.label: पाठ-टिप्पणी
blocks.text: ‘उग्रतपाः’ loses its visarga before the voiced 'b' of ‘बुद्ध्वा’. ‘बुद्ध्वा शरण्यम्’ = knowing (him) to be the refuge.

blocks.label: स्मरण-सूत्र
blocks.text: दीर्घ जीवन → भरद्वाज → इन्द्र की शरण। “कौन किसके पास, और क्यों”: आयुर्वेद की शुरुआत एक शिष्य की दीर्घ आयु की खोज से होती है।

card.rule: Seeking a long life, Bharadvaja, a man of severe austerity, approached Indra, the lord of the immortals, having understood that he was the one fit to give refuge.

concepts.title: श्लोक ४: ब्रह्मणा हि

blocks.label: संदर्भ
blocks.text: चरकसंहिता, सूत्रस्थान, अध्याय १ — श्लोक ४। पाठ: SARIT संस्करण।

words.gram: m. acc. sg.; अव्ययीभाव-त्य्पे adv. + ppp प्र-√वच्

blocks.label: हिन्दी
blocks.text: क्योंकि ब्रह्मा ने जैसा आयुर्वेद कहा था, उसे पहले प्रजापति ने सम्पूर्ण रूप से ग्रहण किया; फिर उनसे दोनों अश्विनीकुमारों ने (ग्रहण किया)।

blocks.label: English
blocks.text: For Prajapati first received Ayurveda (the science of life) in its entirety just as it had been proclaimed by Brahma; then the Ashvins in turn (received it) from him.

blocks.label: पाठ-टिप्पणी
blocks.text: ‘पजापतिः’ → ‘प्रजापतिः’: No word ‘पजापति’ in Sanskrit; प्रजापति is the expected recipient in the lineage ब्रह्मा > प्रजापति > अश्विन्स्. A dropped 'r'. Metre unaffected (16 syllables either way). The verb ‘जग्राह’ must be supplied again (as a dual) for ‘अश्विनौ’. ‘यथाप्रोक्तम्’ could also be read as an adverb (‘एxअच्त्ल्य् अस् इत् wअस् तौघ्त्’). ‘ततः’ = 'from him (प्रजापति)' or simply ‘थेरेअफ़्तेर्’.

card.rule: For Prajapati first received Ayurveda (the science of life) in its entirety just as it had been proclaimed by Brahma; then the Ashvins in turn (received it) from him.

blocks.label: हिन्दी
blocks.text: अश्विनीकुमारों से भगवान् शक्र (इन्द्र) ने उसे सम्पूर्ण रूप से प्राप्त किया। ऋषियों द्वारा कहे जाने पर भरद्वाज इसलिए शक्र के पास गए।

blocks.label: English
blocks.text: From the Ashvins the venerable Shakra (Indra) received it in full. Bharadvaja, asked by the sages, therefore approached Shakra.

blocks.label: पाठ-टिप्पणी
blocks.text: ‘केवलम्’ may qualify the science (‘थे wहोले ओफ़् इत्’) or be adverbial (‘एन्तिरेल्य्’). ‘ऋषिप्रोक्तः’ literally 'spoken to / told by the sages', i.e. requested or deputed by them (cf. verse 19). ‘तस्मात्’ may mean ‘थेरेफ़ोरे’ or 'for that reason (since शक्र had it)'.

card.rule: From the Ashvins the venerable Shakra (Indra) received it in full. Bharadvaja, asked by the sages, therefore approached Shakra.

blocks.label: English
blocks.text: When diseases arose among embodied beings, becoming obstacles to their austerity, fasting, study, celibacy, vows and life,

blocks.label: पाठ-टिप्पणी
blocks.text: Sentence continues into verse 7. ‘तपोपवास’ for tapas + उपवास is the usual (irregular) compound form; not flagged. The genitive compound depends on ‘विघ्नभूताः’ (obstacles to ...); ‘शरीरिणाम्’ can be read with ‘प्रादुर्भूताः’ (arose among) or with the compound (the austerity etc. of embodied beings). ‘ब्रह्मचर्य-व्रत’ may also be taken as one item (‘थे वोw ओफ़् चेलिबच्य्’); the whole compound may alternatively be read as a बहुव्रीहि qualifying शरीरिणाम्.

card.rule: When diseases arose among embodied beings, becoming obstacles to their austerity, fasting, study, celibacy, vows and life,

blocks.text: और समवाय को भी (देखा); जिसे जानकर और शास्त्र में कही गई विधि का पालन करके उन्होंने परम सुख और अनश्वर (चिरस्थायी) जीवन भी प्राप्त किया।

blocks.label: English
blocks.text: and inherence (samavaya). Having known this, and following the regimen prescribed in the treatise, they obtained the highest well-being and also a life that is not transient.

blocks.label: पाठ-टिप्पणी
blocks.text: ‘यत्’ (neuter singular) refers collectively to the six categories of verses 28 and 29. ‘तन्त्र’ = the treatise / science (आयुर्वेद). ‘अनित्वर’ = not transient (itvara 'going, perishable'); i.e. long-lasting rather than literally eternal.

card.rule: and inherence (samavaya). Having known this, and following the regimen prescribed in the treatise, they obtained the highest well-being and also a life that is not transient.

blocks.text: तब मैत्री-परायण पुनर्वसु ने समस्त प्राणियों पर अनुकम्पा के कारण पुण्य आयुर्वेद छह शिष्यों को प्रदान किया।

blocks.label: English
blocks.text: Then Punarvasu, devoted to friendliness, out of compassion for all beings gave the holy Ayurveda (the science of life) to his six disciples.

blocks.label: संदर्भ
blocks.text: चरकसंहिता, सूत्रस्थान, अध्याय १ — श्लोक ३२। पाठ: SARIT संस्करण।

blocks.label: हिन्दी
blocks.text: इसमें (शिष्यों की) बुद्धि की विशेषता थी, मुनि के उपदेश में कोई भेद नहीं था; इसी कारण अग्निवेश सबसे पहले तन्त्र (शास्त्र-ग्रन्थ) के रचयिता हुए।

blocks.label: English
blocks.text: The distinction there lay in intellect, not in any difference in the sage's teaching; that is why Agnivesha became the first author of a treatise (tantra).

blocks.label: पाठ-टिप्पणी
blocks.text: ‘बुद्धेर् विशेषः’ is understood as अग्निवेश's superior intellect (the teaching given to all six was the same). ‘प्रथमम्’ may also be read adjectivally with ‘तन्त्रस्य’ (‘औथोर् ओफ़् थे फ़िर्स्त् त्रेअतिसे’).

card.rule: The distinction there lay in intellect, not in any difference in the sage's teaching; that is why Agnivesha became the first author of a treatise (tantra).

blocks.label: श्लोक
lines: अथ भेलादयश्चक्रुः स्वं स्वं तन्त्रं कृतानि च

concepts.title: श्लोक ३४: श्रुत्वा सूत्रणमर्थानामृषयः

blocks.label: संदर्भ
blocks.text: चरकसंहिता, सूत्रस्थान, अध्याय १ — श्लोक ३४। पाठ: SARIT संस्करण।

blocks.label: हिन्दी
blocks.text: पुण्यकर्मा (शिष्यों) द्वारा विषयों की सूत्र-रूप रचना सुनकर वे ऋषि अत्यन्त प्रसन्न हुए और 'यथावत् सूत्रित किया गया है' ऐसा कहकर उन्होंने उसका अनुमोदन किया।

blocks.label: English
blocks.text: Having heard the systematic composition of the subjects by those of meritorious deeds, the sages, delighted, approved it, saying: "It has been properly composed."

blocks.label: पाठ-टिप्पणी
blocks.text: ‘प्रहृष्टास्त’ → ‘प्रहृष्टास्ते’: Sandhi of प्रहृष्टाः + te before avagraha ('numenire = anumenire) requires ‘ते’, giving 'प्रहृष्टास्ते ‘नुमेनिरे’; ‘स्त’ with avagraha is not a valid form. Likely data-entry typo (Devanagari shows the same). ‘पुण्यकर्मणाम्’ is taken as the agent of ‘सूत्रणम्’ (the composition by those of meritorious deeds, i.e. the disciples); it could alternatively qualify ‘अर्थानाम्’.

card.rule: Having heard the systematic composition of the subjects by those of meritorious deeds, the sages, delighted, approved it, saying: "It has been properly composed."

concepts.title: श्लोक ३५: सर्व एवास्तुवंस्तांश्च

blocks.label: संदर्भ
blocks.text: चरकसंहिता, सूत्रस्थान, अध्याय १ — श्लोक ३५। पाठ: SARIT संस्करण।

blocks.label: हिन्दी
blocks.text: सब प्राणियों का हित चाहने वाले उन सभी (ऋषियों) ने उनकी प्रशंसा की और एक साथ ऊँचे स्वर में कहा — 'साधु! (यह) प्राणियों पर अनुकम्पा है।'

blocks.label: English
blocks.text: All of them, wishing the welfare of all beings, praised them and together said loudly: "Well done! (This is) compassion for living beings."

blocks.label: पाठ-टिप्पणी
blocks.text: ‘सर्व’ = sarve (final -e becomes -a before a vowel, eva). The exclamation may also be construed '(Your) compassion for beings is good (साधु).' ‘सर्वभूतहितैषिणः’ may be acc. pl. agreeing with ‘तान्’ (praised them, who wished the welfare of all beings) rather than nom. pl. with ‘सर्वे’.

card.rule: All of them, wishing the welfare of all beings, praised them and together said loudly: "Well done! (This is) compassion for living beings."

concepts.title: श्लोक ३६: तं पुण्यं

blocks.label: संदर्भ
blocks.text: चरकसंहिता, सूत्रस्थान, अध्याय १ — श्लोक ३६। पाठ: SARIT संस्करण।

blocks.label: श्लोक
lines: तं पुण्यं शुश्रुवुः शब्दं दिवि देवर्षयः स्थिताः

blocks.label: हिन्दी
blocks.text: स्वर्ग में स्थित देवर्षियों ने देवताओं सहित उन परम ऋषियों का वह पुण्य शब्द सुना, और सुनकर वे अत्यन्त प्रसन्न हुए।

blocks.label: English
blocks.text: The divine sages stationed in heaven, together with the gods, heard that holy utterance of the supreme sages, and having heard it they rejoiced greatly.

blocks.label: पाठ-टिप्पणी
blocks.text: ‘परमर्षीणं’ → ‘परमर्षीणां’: Genitive plural of ऋषि ends in -ईणाम् with long आ; short ‘णं’ is ungrammatical and a likely data-entry typo (Devanagari shows the same). The metre cannot decide it: the syllable is heavy either way because of the अनुस्वार. ‘परमर्षीणाम्’ could depend on ‘शब्दम्’ (the sound of the supreme sages) — taken so here.

card.rule: The divine sages stationed in heaven, together with the gods, heard that holy utterance of the supreme sages, and having heard it they rejoiced greatly.

blocks.label: संदर्भ
blocks.text: चरकसंहिता, सूत्रस्थान, अध्याय १ — श्लोक ३७। पाठ: SARIT संस्करण।

blocks.label: हिन्दी
blocks.text: आकाश में प्राणियों द्वारा हर्ष से उच्चारित 'अहो, साधु!' के स्निग्ध और गम्भीर घोष ने तीनों लोकों को गुंजा दिया।

blocks.label: English
blocks.text: The cry "Ah, well done!", smooth and deep, raised in the sky by beings out of joy, made the three worlds resound.

blocks.label: पाठ-टिप्पणी
blocks.text: Variant noted by the edition: ‘-नादयत्’ (अन्वनादयत्, 'made resound/echo', caus. of √nad) for ‘अन्ववादयत्’; the sense is nearly the same. ‘भूतैः’ may mean spirits/celestial beings rather than creatures generally. The variant अन्वनादयत् (caus. of √nad) gives the more natural sense ‘मदे रेसोउन्द्’; अन्ववादयत् as a causative of anu-√vad is possible but unusual. पाठभेद (लोकांस्त्रीनन्ववादयत् के बाद): -नादयत्

card.rule: The cry "Ah, well done!", smooth and deep, raised in the sky by beings out of joy, made the three worlds resound.

blocks.label: हिन्दी
blocks.text: मंगलकारी वायु बहने लगी, सभी दिशाएँ प्रकाश से जगमगा उठीं, और जल-सहित पुष्पों की दिव्य वर्षाएँ होने लगीं।

blocks.label: संदर्भ
blocks.text: चरकसंहिता, सूत्रस्थान, अध्याय १ — श्लोक ३९। पाठ: SARIT संस्करण।

blocks.label: श्लोक
lines: बुद्धिः सिद्धिः स्मृतिर्मेधा धृतिः कीर्तिः क्षमादया ॥ ३९ ॥

blocks.label: हिन्दी
blocks.text: तब अग्निवेश आदि (शिष्यों) में ज्ञान की देवियाँ प्रविष्ट हुईं — बुद्धि, सिद्धि, स्मृति, मेधा, धृति, कीर्ति, क्षमा और दया।

blocks.label: English
blocks.text: Then the deities of knowledge entered Agnivesha and the others headed by him: Intellect, Accomplishment, Memory, Retentive intelligence (medha), Fortitude, Fame, Forbearance and Compassion.

blocks.label: पाठ-टिप्पणी
blocks.text: ‘क्षमादया’ is two words, क्षमा and दया, written without a space (no sandhi change; Devanagari likewise joined). It is not ‘क्षमा-आदयः’ ('forbearance etc.'), which would be masculine plural and break the list of feminine deities.

card.rule: Then the deities of knowledge entered Agnivesha and the others headed by him: Intellect, Accomplishment, Memory, Retentive intelligence (medha), Fortitude, Fame, Forbearance and Compassion.

blocks.text: चरकसंहिता, सूत्रस्थान, अध्याय १ — श्लोक ४०। पाठ: SARIT संस्करण।

blocks.label: हिन्दी

concepts.title: श्लोक ४१: हिताहितं सुखं

blocks.label: संदर्भ
blocks.text: चरकसंहिता, सूत्रस्थान, अध्याय १ — श्लोक ४१। पाठ: SARIT संस्करण।

blocks.label: श्लोक
lines: मानं च तच्च यत्रोक्तमायुर्वेदः स उच्यते ॥ ४१ ॥

blocks.label: हिन्दी
blocks.text: हितकर और अहितकर, सुखी और दुःखी आयु, उस आयु के लिए क्या हितकर और क्या अहितकर है, उसका मान (परिमाण) और स्वयं वह आयु — ये जहाँ कहे गए हों, वह आयुर्वेद कहलाता है।

blocks.label: English
blocks.text: That in which beneficial and harmful life, happy and unhappy life, what is wholesome and unwholesome for that life, its measure, and life itself are stated, is called Ayurveda.

blocks.label: पाठ-टिप्पणी
blocks.text: ‘दुखमायुस्तस्य’ → ‘दुःखमायुस्तस्य’: ‘दुखम्’ lacks the visarga of दुःखम्; with दुः the 7th syllable of the odd पाद becomes heavy (regular पथ्या pattern), so the metre supports दुःखम्. Likely data-entry typo (Devanagari also shows दुखम्). ‘आयुः’ is qualified by हिताहितम्, sukham, दुःखम् (four kinds of life: hita, ahita, sukha, दुःख). The first ‘हिताहितम्’ qualifies आयुः; the second (‘तस्य हिताहितम्’) means what is wholesome and unwholesome for it. ‘मानम्’ = the measure (span) of life. Masculine ‘सः’ agrees with ‘आयुर्वेदः’.

card.rule: That in which beneficial and harmful life, happy and unhappy life, what is wholesome and unwholesome for that life, its measure, and life itself are stated, is called Ayurveda.

concepts.title: श्लोक ४२: शरीरेन्द्रियसत्त्वात्मसंयोगो धारि

blocks.label: संदर्भ
blocks.text: चरकसंहिता, सूत्रस्थान, अध्याय १ — श्लोक ४२। पाठ: SARIT संस्करण।

words.gloss: union of body, senses, mind, self
words.gram: m. nom. sg.; द्वन्द्व within तत्-पुरुष

blocks.label: हिन्दी
blocks.text: शरीर, इन्द्रिय, सत्त्व (मन) और आत्मा का संयोग आयु है; पर्यायवाची शब्दों से उसे धारि, जीवित, नित्यग और अनुबन्ध कहा जाता है।

blocks.label: English
blocks.text: The union of body, sense faculties, mind (sattva) and self is life (ayus); by synonyms life is called dhari (sustaining), jivita (living), nityaga (ever-moving) and anubandha (continuity).

blocks.label: पाठ-टिप्पणी
blocks.text: Syntax: the union (संयोग) is the definition of आयुस्; धारि, जीवितम्, नित्यगः, अनुबन्धः are the synonyms. ‘नित्यग’ is variously explained as 'constantly going (moving on)' or ‘एवेर्-प्रेसेन्त्’; ‘अनुबन्ध’ as 'continuity (linking successive moments)'.

card.rule: The union of body, sense faculties, mind (sattva) and self is life (ayus); by synonyms life is called dhari (sustaining), jivita (living), nityaga (ever-moving) and anubandha (continuity).

blocks.text: The Veda (science) of that life is regarded by the knowers of the Vedas as the most holy; that which is beneficial to human beings in both worlds will now be expounded.

'yat ... hitam' is neuter while ‘वेदः’ is masculine, so ‘यत्’ is best taken as 'that which (is beneficial)', the content to be taught, rather than as a relative to वेदः. ‘लोकयोः उभयोः’ may be locative or genitive dual (‘ओफ़् बोथ् wओर्ल्द्स्’); this world and the next are meant. ‘वक्ष्यते’ form is middle/passive future of √vac.

blocks.text: चरकसंहिता, सूत्रस्थान, अध्याय १ — श्लोक ४४। पाठ: SARIT संस्करण।

blocks.text: Commonality (samanya) is always the cause of increase of all entities, and distinctiveness (vishesha) the cause of decrease; but the operation (pravritti) belongs to both.

concepts.title: श्लोक ४८: खादीन्यात्मा मनः

blocks.label: संदर्भ
blocks.text: चरकसंहिता, सूत्रस्थान, अध्याय १ — श्लोक ४८। पाठ: SARIT संस्करण।

blocks.label: हिन्दी
blocks.text: ख (आकाश) आदि (पाँच भूत), आत्मा, मन, काल और दिशाएँ — यह द्रव्यों का संग्रह है। इन्द्रिय-युक्त द्रव्य चेतन है और इन्द्रिय-रहित अचेतन।

blocks.text: The (five elements) beginning with kha (space), the self, mind, time and the directions: this is the summary of substances (dravya). Substance possessing sense faculties is sentient; that without sense faculties is non-sentient.

blocks.text: ‘खादीनि’ = the five भूतस्: kha/आकाश, वायु, agni, jala, पृथिवी (the list is implied, not stated).

concepts.title: श्लोक ४९: सार्था गुर्वादयो

blocks.label: संदर्भ
blocks.text: चरकसंहिता, सूत्रस्थान, अध्याय १ — श्लोक ४९। पाठ: SARIT संस्करण।

blocks.label: हिन्दी
blocks.text: इन्द्रिय-विषयों (अर्थों) सहित गुरु आदि, बुद्धि, प्रयत्न-पर्यन्त (गुण) और पर आदि — ये गुण कहे गए हैं। प्रयत्न से आरम्भ होने वाली चेष्टा को कर्म कहा जाता है।

blocks.label: English
blocks.text: Together with the sense-objects (artha), those beginning with guru (heavy), intellect (buddhi) and those ending with effort (prayatna), and those beginning with para (priority): these are declared to be the qualities (guna). Action (karma) is called movement (ceshtita) initiated by effort.

blocks.label: पाठ-टिप्पणी
blocks.text: Medium confidence: split or sense is less certain. Very compressed list. ‘सार्थाः’ = with the sense-objects (sound etc.); ‘गुर्वादयः’ = the twenty qualities beginning with heavy; ‘बुद्धिः प्रयत्नान्ताः’ is usually read as 'buddhi and the (psychic qualities) ending with prayatna' (इच्छा, द्वेष, sukha, दुःख, prayatna); ‘परादयः’ = para, apara, yukti, etc. Whether ‘प्रयत्नान्ताः’ is a separate group or qualifies buddhi is construed differently; the translation keeps it neutral. ‘प्रयत्नादि’ (n. sg.) qualifies ‘कर्म’ (action preceded by effort).

card.rule: Together with the sense-objects (artha), those beginning with guru (heavy), intellect (buddhi) and those ending with effort (prayatna), and those beginning with para (priority): these are declared to be the qualities (guna). Action (karma) is called movement (ceshtita) initiated by effort.

lines: संयोगे च विभागे च कारणं द्रव्यमाश्रितम्

blocks.text: संयोग और विभाग में कारण, द्रव्य में आश्रित, और करने योग्य (कार्य) की क्रिया — यह कर्म है; कर्म किसी अन्य की अपेक्षा नहीं रखता।

blocks.text: Medium confidence: split or sense is less certain. The instrumental ‘सत्त्वभूतगुणेन्द्रियैः’ is taken with ‘चैतन्ये कारणम्’ (the self causes consciousness in association with these); it could also be construed with ‘निर्विकारः’ ('unaffected by mind, elements...'), which is less usual. ‘चैतन्ये’ is a locative of purpose (‘चौसे इन् रेगर्द् तो चोन्स्चिओउस्नेस्स्’). ‘गुण’ may mean the qualities of the elements (sense-objects).

card.rule: The supreme self, however, is unchanging; together with mind, the elements, the qualities and the senses it is the cause of consciousness. It is eternal and the seer, for it witnesses actions.

words.gloss: from the fruit- and root-yielding plants
words.gram: m./n. inst. pl. of फलमूलिन् (द्वन्द्व फल-मूल + poss. -in)

blocks.label: हिन्दी
blocks.text: अब तीन अन्य वृक्ष हैं जो फलिनी और मूलिनी (औषधियों) से भिन्न हैं — स्नुही, अर्क और अश्मन्तक; उनका अलग-अलग कर्म यह है:

blocks.text: Now there are three other plants, distinct from the fruit-yielding and root-yielding ones: snuhi, arka and ashmantaka. Their action, each separately, is as follows:

concepts.title: श्लोक ११५: वमने ऽश्मन्तकं

blocks.label: संदर्भ
blocks.text: चरकसंहिता, सूत्रस्थान, अध्याय १ — श्लोक ११५। पाठ: SARIT संस्करण।

concepts.title: श्लोक ११६: इमांस्त्रीनपरान् वृक्षानाहुर्येषां

blocks.label: संदर्भ
blocks.text: चरकसंहिता, सूत्रस्थान, अध्याय १ — श्लोक ११६। पाठ: SARIT संस्करण।

blocks.label: श्लोक
lines: पूतीकः कृष्णगन्धा च तिल्वकश्च तथा तरुः ॥ ११६ ॥

blocks.label: हिन्दी
blocks.text: इन तीन अन्य वृक्षों को (भी) बताया गया है, जिनकी छालें हितकर हैं — पूतीक, कृष्णगन्धा और उसी प्रकार तिल्वक वृक्ष।

blocks.label: English
blocks.text: They speak of these three other trees whose barks are beneficial: Putika, Krishnagandha, and likewise the tree Tilvaka.

blocks.label: पाठ-टिप्पणी
blocks.text: ‘अपरान्’ (other) contrasts these three bark-trees with the three latex-trees listed just before. ‘तथा तरुः’ is literally ‘अन्द् लिकेwइसे थे त्रेए’, i.e. Tilvaka, which is a tree. Identifications of the plants (e.g. कृष्णगन्धा as शिग्रु) belong to the commentaries, not this text.

card.rule: They speak of these three other trees whose barks are beneficial: Putika, Krishnagandha, and likewise the tree Tilvaka.

concepts.title: श्लोक ११७: विरेचने प्रयोक्तव्यः

blocks.label: संदर्भ
blocks.text: चरकसंहिता, सूत्रस्थान, अध्याय १ — श्लोक ११७। पाठ: SARIT संस्करण।

words.gram: fut. pass. part. प्र-√युज्, m. nom. sg.

blocks.label: हिन्दी
blocks.text: विरेचन में पूतीक और उसी प्रकार तिल्वक का प्रयोग करना चाहिए; कृष्णगन्धा परीसर्प, शोथ और अर्श में (प्रयोग के योग्य) बताई गई है।

blocks.label: English
blocks.text: Putika and likewise Tilvaka are to be used in purgation; Krishnagandha is prescribed for parisarpa (a spreading skin disease), swellings and piles.

blocks.label: पाठ-टिप्पणी
blocks.text: ‘शोथेष्वर्शःषु’ → ‘शोथेष्वर्शःसु’: possible: loc. pl. of अर्शस् is अर्शःसु (or अर्शस्सु); after visarga preceded by a the s is not retroflexed, so ष् looks like a typo or orthographic slip (the Devanagari has the same ष). ‘प्रयोक्तव्यः’ is singular though it governs two subjects (पूतीक and Tilvaka); it agrees with the nearer one or each separately. ‘उच्यते’ is literally ‘इस् सैद्’, i.e. said to be indicated. The list of conditions for कृष्णगन्धा continues into the next verse.

card.rule: Putika and likewise Tilvaka are to be used in purgation; Krishnagandha is prescribed for parisarpa (a spreading skin disease), swellings and piles.

blocks.label: संदर्भ
blocks.text: चरकसंहिता, सूत्रस्थान, अध्याय १ — श्लोक ११८। पाठ: SARIT संस्करण।

words.gram: संख्या-पूर्व कर्मधारय (or षट् + वृक्षान्), m. acc. pl.

blocks.label: हिन्दी
blocks.text: (कृष्णगन्धा) दद्रु, विद्रधि, गण्ड, कुष्ठ और अलजी में भी (प्रयुक्त होती है)। विचक्षण (वैद्य) इन छह वृक्षों को शोधन (करने वाले) भी जाने।

blocks.text: (Krishnagandha is also used) in ringworm, abscess, ganda (glandular swellings), kushtha (skin diseases) and alaji (pustular eruptions). The discerning (physician) should also know these six trees as purifying (shodhana).

blocks.label: पाठ-टिप्पणी
blocks.text: The first line continues the uses of कृष्णगन्धा from v. 117 (loc. pl. parallel to परीसर्पे etc.). ‘षड्वृक्षान्’ can be read as a dvigu compound or as two words षट् वृक्षान्; the sense is the same. ‘ञ्छ्’ is sandhi of -n + श्-. गण्ड may mean goitre/glandular swelling or boil.

card.rule: (Krishnagandha is also used) in ringworm, abscess, ganda (glandular swellings), kushtha (skin diseases) and alaji (pustular eruptions). The discerning (physician) should also know these six trees as purifying (shodhana).

concepts.title: श्लोक ११९: इत्युक्ताः फलमूलिन्यः

blocks.label: संदर्भ
blocks.text: चरकसंहिता, सूत्रस्थान, अध्याय १ — श्लोक ११९। पाठ: SARIT संस्करण।

blocks.label: श्लोक
lines: मूत्रं क्षीराणि वृक्षाश्च षड् ये दिष्टपयस्त्वचः ॥ ११९ ॥

words.gloss: whose milk and bark are indicated

blocks.label: हिन्दी
blocks.text: इस प्रकार फलिनी और मूलिनी (औषधियाँ), स्नेह, लवण, मूत्र, दूध और वे छह वृक्ष, जिनका दूध (क्षीर) और छाल (उपयोगी) बताए गए हैं — (इन सबका) वर्णन किया गया।

blocks.label: English
blocks.text: Thus have been stated the fruit-plants and root-plants, the fats, the salts, urine, the milks, and the six trees whose milk (latex) and bark have been indicated.

blocks.label: पाठ-टिप्पणी
blocks.text: Medium confidence: split or sense is less certain. Summary of the preceding section. ‘दिष्टपयस्त्वचः’ is taken as a बहुव्रीहि: दिष्ट (indicated) + payas (milk, i.e. latex) + tvac (bark): ‘wहोसे मिल्क् अन्द् बर्क् अरे इन्दिचतेद्’ (three trees for latex, three for bark). The compound reading fits the metre (16 syllables). ‘फलमूलिन्यः’ = फलिन्यः and मूलिन्यः (cf. v. 138 मूलिन्यश् ca फलिन्यश् ca).

card.rule: Thus have been stated the fruit-plants and root-plants, the fats, the salts, urine, the milks, and the six trees whose milk (latex) and bark have been indicated.

blocks.text: चरकसंहिता, सूत्रस्थान, अध्याय १ — श्लोक १२१। पाठ: SARIT संस्करण।

concepts.title: श्लोक १२२: योगवित्त्वप्यरूपज्ञस्तासां तत्त्वविदुच्यते

blocks.label: संदर्भ
blocks.text: चरकसंहिता, सूत्रस्थान, अध्याय १ — श्लोक १२२। पाठ: SARIT संस्करण।

blocks.label: श्लोक
lines: पुरुषं पुरुषं वीक्ष्य स ज्ञेयो भिषगुत्तमः ॥ १२३ ॥

fut. pass. part. √ज्ञा, m. nom. sg.

blocks.text: जैसे विष, जैसे शस्त्र, जैसे अग्नि और जैसे वज्र (होते हैं), वैसे ही अज्ञात औषध (घातक) है; और भली-भाँति ज्ञात (औषध) अमृत के समान है।

blocks.label: English
blocks.text: Like poison, like a weapon, like fire, like a thunderbolt is a medicine that is not (properly) known; when well known, it is like nectar (amrita).

blocks.label: पाठ-टिप्पणी

card.rule: Like poison, like a weapon, like fire, like a thunderbolt is a medicine that is not (properly) known; when well known, it is like nectar (amrita).

blocks.label: हिन्दी
blocks.text: उचित प्रयोग (योग) से तीक्ष्ण विष भी उत्तम औषध बन सकता है; और औषध भी गलत ढंग से प्रयुक्त होने पर तीक्ष्ण विष बन जाता है।

blocks.text: Through proper application even a potent poison may become an excellent medicine; and a medicine, too, when wrongly applied, becomes a potent poison.

card.rule: Through proper application even a potent poison may become an excellent medicine; and a medicine, too, when wrongly applied, becomes a potent poison.

card.rule: Indra's thunderbolt, falling on one's head, might yet leave something remaining (leave one alive); but a medicine prescribed by an ignorant person would not leave the patient with anything remaining.

concepts.title: श्लोक १३२: नतु श्रुतवतां

blocks.label: संदर्भ
blocks.text: चरकसंहिता, सूत्रस्थान, अध्याय १ — श्लोक १३२। पाठ: SARIT संस्करण।

blocks.label: श्लोक
lines: गृहीतमन्नं पानं वा वित्तं वा रोगपीडितात् ॥ १३२ ॥

words.gloss: from one who has sought refuge

blocks.label: हिन्दी
blocks.text: किन्तु विद्वानों का वेश धारण करने वाले (अज्ञानी) के द्वारा, शरण में आए हुए रोग-पीड़ित व्यक्ति से अन्न, पान या धन लेना (अच्छा) नहीं है।

blocks.label: English
blocks.text: But not (is it better) for one who wears the garb of the learned to have taken food, drink or money from a disease-afflicted person who has come to him for refuge.

blocks.label: पाठ-टिप्पणी
blocks.text: ‘वेशं’ → ‘वेषं’: possible: 'garb, dress' is normally वेष; वेश (dwelling) and वेष are often confused in manuscripts and editions, so this may be an orthographic variant rather than a real error. Completes v. 131 (varam ... na tu). ‘नतु’ is written as one token in the source; it is na + tu. ‘श्रुतवतां वेशं बिभ्रता’ = a pretender who only looks like a learned physician. ‘गृहीतम्’ is the impersonal predicate parallel to ‘पीतम्’ in v. 131.

card.rule: But not (is it better) for one who wears the garb of the learned to have taken food, drink or money from a disease-afflicted person who has come to him for refuge.

blocks.text: चरकसंहिता, सूत्रस्थान, अध्याय १ — श्लोक १३३। पाठ: SARIT संस्करण।

An alternative reading: ‘अ फ्य्सिचिअन् देसिरिन्ग् तो प्रोस्पेर्’ (बुभूषु can mean wishing for well-being). ‘सम्पद्’ = "abundance, perfection, accomplishment". blocks.label: हिन्दी
blocks.text: मूत्र, दूध (क्षीर) और वे छह वृक्ष जिनका आश्रय (उपयोगी अंग) दूध और छाल है; इन सबके कर्म; और उचित तथा अनुचित प्रयोग के गुण और दोष —

blocks.label: पाठ-टिप्पणी
blocks.text: Medium confidence: split or sense is less certain. ‘क्षीरत्वगाश्रयाः’ = ‘हविन्ग् लतेx अन्द् बर्क् अस् थेइर् सेअत्’, parallel to ‘दिष्टपयस्त्वचः’ in v. 119. ‘योगायोगगुणागुणाः’ can be resolved as "the गुणस् (merits) and अगुणस् (faults) of yoga (proper use) and ayoga (improper use)", or as a four-member dvandva (proper use, improper use, merits, faults).

blocks.label: संदर्भ
blocks.text: चरकसंहिता, सूत्रस्थान, अध्याय १ — श्लोक १४०। पाठ: SARIT संस्करण।

blocks.label: श्लोक
lines: वैद्यापवादो यत्रस्थाः सर्वे च भिषजां गुणाः

blocks.label: हिन्दी
blocks.text: वैद्य की निन्दा (अर्थात् अयोग्य वैद्य की भर्त्सना) और (वह प्रसंग) जिसमें वैद्यों के सभी गुण स्थित हैं — यह सब महर्षि ने प्रथम अध्याय में भली-भाँति कहा है।

blocks.label: English
blocks.text: the censure of (unworthy) physicians, and (the passage) in which all the qualities of physicians are found — all this has been fully explained by the great sage in the first chapter.

blocks.label: पाठ-टिप्पणी
blocks.text: Medium confidence: split or sense is less certain. Closes the summary list begun in v. 136. "यत्रस्थाः ... गुणाः" is literally "the qualities ... which stand where"; it is taken as "(the section) in which all the physician's qualities are set out"; it may also be read loosely as "and all the qualities of physicians, as they are found (there)". ‘पूर्वाध्याये’ = literally "in the foremost/preceding chapter", i.e. this first chapter (an interpretation). The ‘ग्रेअत् सगे’ is the teacher of the chapter (आत्रेय), not named here. Alternatively yatra may refer to a person: '(the physician) in whom all the qualities of physicians reside' (cf. vv. 133-135); a reviewer reports commentators read it so, to be checked against चक्रपाणि.

card.rule: the censure of (unworthy) physicians, and (the passage) in which all the qualities of physicians are found — all this has been fully explained by the great sage in the first chapter.
